BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


        SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago - the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance, be amended by changing all the B3-2 Communiiy Shopping District symbols and

'indications as shown on Map No. 7-G in the area bounded by


        the alley next north of and parallel to West Diversey Parkway; a line 51
        feet east of and parallel to North Southport Avenue; West Diversey
        Parkway; and a line 25 feet east of and parallel to North Southport
        Avenue,

to those of a B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

        SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its

 passage and due publication.
